about_the_game:
Enter a world where the boundaries between realities are blurred. Blackwood Manor is not just a place, but a prison for the soul, shattered into fragments of time. Like Daniel, you came here in search of the truth, but found yourself trapped in a terrifying mind game. Your only key to freedom and understanding is an ancient Polaroid camera, capable of capturing the invisible.

Photograph old paintings, and each developed image will become a bridge to the house's past—to the days when the tragedy was just beginning. But beware: the closer you get to solving the mystery, the more active and aggressive the "Echo" becomes—a ruthless entity dwelling within the walls of the Present, feeding on your fear. Collect journal fragments, solve puzzles, and evade pursuit to assemble the "Sealer" and bring peace to the house... or become its next victim.

As you progress, you'll need to find keys and open locked doors, solve puzzles, and find passages. This is a first-person game with horror elements. Explore the house and its rooms, collect batteries for your flashlight, and solve riddles. The darkness can hide various secrets.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3570K or AMD FX-8310
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 670 / GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon HD 7870
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: INTEL CORE I7-8700K or AMD RYZEN 5 3600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 1080Ti or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
